I remember Tom answering this one awhile back and the answer is yes.

The rules team believes you cannot play a prebent damage card except
during the damage resolution subphase of a combat round.

>I remember Tom answering this one awhile back and the answer is yes.

>The rules team believes you cannot play a prebent damage card except
>during the damage resolution subphase of a combat round.

And, the rules team has ruled that damage from superior Rutor's Hand
is to be treated as "damage dealt during strike resolution", so all
normal damage prevention cards apply (but you can't dodge or S:CE,
since you aren't granted a strike in reply).
